Generates a bundle composition report at docs/perf/bundle-report.html using vite-bundle-visualizer. Manual channel only — artifact, not gating.
Detects stale claims on docs/ai/orchestration.json units. A claim goes stale when status=claimed and claimedAt is older than the stale-threshold (default 4h).

Dependency vulnerability audit wrapping pnpm audit --audit-level moderate. Translates each advisory into a registry violation; critical/high are errors, moderate/low are warnings. Manual channel only (network required).
TODO: add description — audit-exceptions.mjs has no leading JSDoc block.

Static purity audit. Scans every registered gate's source for fs writes, Date.now / Math.random, network imports, and process.env access outside an allowlist. Produces docs/guardrails/purity-audit.md. Warn-only by default; --strict exits 1 on any IMPURE-without-exception gate.

Planning artifact: reads registry.json and produces a per-gate replaceability verdict (fully-replaceable / partially-replaceable / genuinely-custom) with industry-tool replacements and migration cost estimates. Output: /tmp/gate-replaceability-audit.json + docs/guardrails/gate-replaceability-plan.md. Manual channel only — run on demand when evaluating gate rationalization.

Meta-gate ratchet for the --json rollout (per unit 13p-8). For each registered gate outside pnpm-meta, spawns `node <gateScript> --json` with a 30s timeout and verifies stdout parses as { violations: Array }. Reports compliance counters; emits Violation rows for non-compliant gates so they surface in the strict-gate inventory. Severity:warn initially; flip to error once 100% comply.

Orphan-module sweeper. Wraps knip --reporter json's unused-files category (parsed.files) and reports each as a warn-severity violation — source files no entry point or import graph reaches. Never blocks (warn only, same precedent as audit-deps). Run via 'pnpm audit:orphan-modules'.

Scans every branch ahead of main and classifies each commit as tracked/orphan based on whether it has a 'Refs: <task-id>' line that points to an open Hermes Kanban task. Companion to check-commit-message-task-ref (which catches new orphans pre-commit); this catches the existing backlog. Always exits 0 — purely informational. Run via 'pnpm audit:wip'. Writes docs/guardrails/orphan-wip-report.json.

Token compliance auditor for page surfaces. This is intentionally looser than audit-components.mjs — reusable components must be strict, pages must still avoid raw design values but can keep justified editorial layout.
Generates a CycloneDX Software Bill of Materials at docs/security/sbom.json. Manual channel — produces an artifact, not a gate. Useful for the GRC narrative and supply-chain review.

Site-quality / redesign-need auditor (#21). Reads custom-site leads from Supabase, calls Google PageSpeed Insights, and scores each site (0-100 inverse). Operator CLI + data tool, not a guardrail — ci-dispatch channel (workflow_dispatch, no cron), needs PAGESPEED_API_KEY + migration 0006.

Meta-audit: reads registry.json, filters to soft-channel gates (manual / pnpm-meta / ci-scheduled), runs each gate against the current tree, and emits a triage report at /tmp/soft-gates-audit.json + docs/guardrails/soft-gate-promotion-plan.md. Classifies each gate as promote-to-pre-commit, promote-to-pre-push, promote-to-ci-pr, baseline-then-promote, investigate-broken, or stay-soft. Runs on demand; never modifies firingChannel values.
Verifies that each documented differentiator in docs/architecture/strengths-and-differentiators.md is still real.
Keeps the attribution registry machine-checkable. Checks that registry IDs in ATTRIBUTIONS.md are present and unique, and that asset manifest sourceId values resolve to known registry IDs.

gates.description: Warns at commit time when the current branch is no longer based on origin/main. This repo squash-merges, so the instant a PR lands the source branch is unrelated to main in BOTH directions; committing there builds a fork whose PR carries phantom diffs reverting whatever else landed. The stop hook makes it worse by reporting the orphaned pointer as 'unpushed commits' and advising a push. Note the obvious check is INVERTED and wrong: 'merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main' is false for every healthy in-progress branch. Reads the locally-known origin/main and never fetches. Never blocks — run-gates fails on any non-zero exit regardless of severity (ops#304), so this exits 0 except under --fixture-mode. ops#335.

Validates that commits on feature branches reference an open Hermes Kanban task via 'Refs: <task-id>' line in the commit body. Wired in .husky/commit-msg. Warn-only by default; promote with KANBAN_REF_ENFORCE=error. Skips main/release/*/hotfix/*, [skip-kanban] tag, merge/revert commits. Accepts kanban IDs (t_<hex>) and legacy unit IDs (1[0-9][a-z]-<n>).
Validates structural invariants of HDS documentation pages. Checks that foundation pages have DocPageHeader and at least one section.

gates.description: Per-file DOM-node budget lock (ratchet) for src/app: counts JSX elements per component/page via the TypeScript AST and locks each file's count against docs/guardrails/baselines/check-dom-node-budgets.json. Files that grow past their budget fail; files that shrink tighten; new files are recorded.

Graceful-degradation guard around editorconfig-checker: runs the real tool and forwards clean passes / real violations untouched, but skips with a named warning (exit 0) when the tool's own binary download failed or timed out, so a network-blocked session doesn't void the rest of the check chain.
Keeps escape hatches visible and well-formed. Checks that only known exemption markers are used and every exemption marker includes a non-empty reason after the colon.

B-class monotonic-decrement ratchet: asserts the withStubFixtures count from validate-fixture-proof-of-firing never increases. Any regression (new stub fixture added) fails the PR. Burn down by replacing stubs with real fixtures.
A11y focus state checker for HDS components and pages. Every interactive element must have a visible focus indicator.

Flags a docs/ai/HANDOFF.md "Now" bullet whose claim is contradicted by a newer dated "Decisions" entry on the same topic (ops#210) — e.g. a lifted freeze left standing as an active Now bullet.
Catches hardcoded color values in non-CSS color contexts that bypass the CSS custom property cascade and are invisible to check-inline-styles / check-tier-bypass.

Layout-integrity Playwright suite (pnpm run test:layout: route coverage + tests/layout-integrity.spec.ts against a vite build/preview server on :5200, built into node_modules/.cache/playwright-preview so no other gate rebuilding dist/ can clobber it). Fails on any layout collision, overflow, or uncovered route. Formerly a bespoke quality.yml step; folded into the registry by ops#241.

gates.description: License compliance gate. Runs pnpm licenses list --prod and blocks copyleft/restrictive licenses (GPL/AGPL/LGPL/SSPL/BUSL/EUPL/OSL/CC-BY-NC/CDDL).

Unified link integrity gate: (1) active docs do not point at missing local files, (2) external href URLs return non-4xx, (3) internal route targets are known app routes. Merged from check-doc-references, check-external-links, check-route-links (13z-6).
Verifies that interactive components ship with motion feedback — the HDS standard that every user action has a visible, token-timed response.

Asserts /ops's live data path, not just a 200 (ops#347, script half of #318). Hits GET /api/tasks as a headless agent and fails on the paused-database shape ({ tasks: [] } with rows expected); where SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN is set, also reads the Supabase project's status directly and distinguishes INACTIVE/COMING_UP/RESTORING/healthy. Notifies via lib/ops/notify.mjs on failure. Runs standalone today (no workflow file present, by design — #347 scope); firingChannel is 'manual' until parent #318's ~6h cron caller lands in a human .github/workflows/* PR, at which point flip this to 'ci-scheduled' (check-validator-wiring.mjs enforces the declared channel matches an actual caller, so declaring ci-scheduled before that caller exists would itself be a wiring-drift violation).
Verifies that the HDS motion system respects prefers-reduced-motion at both layers: CSS transitions and Motion (Framer Motion) animations.

Pre-commit secrets scanner wrapping the gitleaks binary. Registers gitleaks in the guardrail registry so it shows up in audits and fixture-proof runs.

Blocks personal data from entering git (ops#27, ops#35). Scans lines ADDED by the staged change, plus staged paths, for denylist terms (real client/contact identifiers loaded from the PII_DENYLIST env/secret or the gitignored .pii-denylist file, never the repo) and private Google/Microsoft/SharePoint/Wix workspace links, which block; emails outside a reviewed allowlist and US phone numbers only warn, because run-gates blocks on a failing error-severity gate (ops#306) and this gate is registered error, so any non-zero exit stops the commit — only the error-severity rules drive that exit code (--fail-on error, the default), and the 2026-09-16 sweep measured emails/phones at ~11% precision. Denylist terms also match decoded and loosened copies of the text (percent/JSON/HTML escapes, accents, slugs, camelCase, comment-wrapped lines); UTF-16 and .gitattributes-binary text is scanned; copies of the denylist are blocked. With nothing staged (the post-commit re-run) it scans HEAD and its message, so a --no-verify bypass is logged. Output shows rule, location and match length, never the value. Commit messages: .husky/commit-msg via scripts/pii-commit-msg.mjs. CI backstop (added lines, commit messages, PR title/body/branch name): .github/workflows/pii-scan.yml; weekly issue-text and sibling-repo sweep: pii-weekly.yml. Guide: docs/guardrails/pii-gate.md.
Local security and dependency hygiene baseline. Checks that no committed runtime env files, npm credentials, obvious secrets, external font/CDN imports, or dangerous HTML injection exist in source.
Verifies every skill pinned in skills-lock.json is installed under .claude/skills/<id>/ and hash-matches the lock. Read-only; run install-skills.mjs to fetch a missing/stale skill.

Warns when a committed snapshot baseline JSON is older than any of its source files — catching baselines that should have been regenerated after a source change but weren't. Covers fixtures/figma-masters/snapshot-pre-8v3.json (sources: pipeline/figma-masters-batch.mjs + public/hds-manifest.json) and fixtures/doc-pages/snapshot.json (sources: src/app/pages/docs/**/*.tsx). Warn-only by default; set STALENESS_ENFORCE=error to make blocking.

Anti-rot gate for docs/specs/<epic-slug>.md (ops#294, doctrine §2 rule 4). Flags a spec missing a parseable Status:/Last verified: header, an active spec whose Last verified is >60 days old, an active spec whose referenced issues are all closed (should be shipped), and a referenced issue number that doesn't exist in the stated repo. A shipped/abandoned spec is exempt from every check — history, not instruction. Advisory only. Manual channel only (network required for issue state).

Caps the always-on agent context listed in docs/guardrails/steering-budget.json. Every file there is loaded by every agent in every session before it reads code; on 2026-09-14 that set was ~189KB/~47k tokens, HANDOFF.md alone 119KB against its own 'keep it one page' instruction. Fix a violation by moving history to an on-demand file, not by raising the budget. ops#292.
Enforces the primitive -> semantic -> component aliasing hierarchy in source files. Direct use of var(--primitive-*) in component and page files bypasses the semantic tier.

Type-coverage floor (pnpm run check:type-coverage: type-coverage --at-least 99.9). Fails when coverage drops below the floor set in package.json. Formerly a bespoke quality.yml step; folded into the registry by ops#241.
gates.skipMetaProbe: re-runs the whole-program type-coverage analysis — the ci-pr run already reports it; a meta-probe copy only duplicates the work

gates.description: Whole-program TypeScript typecheck (pnpm run typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.typecheck.json). Fails on any type error. Formerly a bespoke quality.yml step; folded into the registry by ops#241.

gates.description: Catches static multi-column gridTemplateColumns values with no nearby isMobile guard. Every multi-column grid must be responsive.
Meta-validator: every gate registered in docs/guardrails/registry.json has a firingChannel that matches actual invocation. Catches aspirational guardrails — gates registered but never really firing.

Pure observer that reads registry.json, orchestration.json, swarm-watchdog-decisions.jsonl, tsconfig.json, and component-api.json. Computes Score A (Internal Integrity, 6 dims) + Score B (Industry Benchmark, 8 dims) per the 13s-strength-1 ADR. Emits docs/guardrails/strength-report.md and strength-report.json. Idempotent (same input → byte-identical output modulo timestamp). Fast (<2s). No mutations to source files.

Reads the fleet's Ralph park trail (ralph-attempt-failed, the park comment, ralph-blocked) via GitHub Search, pairs each park/blocked signal with the next human comment as its recovery, and appends the raw pair to docs/ai/learned-rules.jsonl (source: park-harvest). No distillation — promote-learned-rule.mjs is the HITL step. Dry-run by default; --apply persists. Manual channel only (network required). ops#298.

Finds issues whose Ralph work merged but which never auto-closed (GitHub's closing-keyword linkage silently not firing), plus merged PR bodies that wrap the closing reference in markdown so it cannot link. Dry-run by default; --apply closes them. Manual channel only (network required). ops#305.

Meta-validator: walks registry.json and asserts every registered gate has a fixture pair (violating + passing). Stub fixtures warn; missing fixtures error; real fixtures run the gate and assert correct exit codes. mtime-scoped for fast pre-commit runs.
Validates docs/ai/orchestration.json schema. In strict mode (--strict-validation), additionally asserts all approved units have a valid validationCmd. Pre-commit MUST invoke the strict form.

Evaluates the re-entry triggers in docs/ai/PARKED.md, the file holding work deliberately kept out of the issue queue. date: and path: triggers fire automatically; issue:/event: triggers surface at the quarterly review. Exits non-zero when an entry is due to re-enter the queue, and prints a recurring entry's own `when it fires:` instruction in place of file-and-delete. Runs daily via .github/workflows/parked-triggers.yml, where a fired trigger fails the scheduled run so the reminder does not depend on memory; `pnpm parked:check` runs it on demand. Read-only — re-entry stays a deliberate human act. Warn severity: a fired trigger is information, not a defect in the commit.

Lists every open sev1 issue (gh search, owner hirobius — the ladder labels live in ops and hds) and exits non-zero while any exists (ops#317). Severity is orthogonal to p0–p3: sev1 = legal exposure, security incident, data loss, or already affecting a real third party. ops#27 sat at p1 for 71 days with nothing surfacing it. Warn severity: it reports, it never blocks a commit. /ops/standing shows the same list without running a command. A gh failure reports the result as UNKNOWN, never as clean.

Over a rolling window (default 14 days), the share of merged PRs whose diff touches the revenue path (lib/agent, lib/leads, lib/lead-gen, lib/render, lib/outreach, api/lead-action.ts, the ops leads UI). Network required (GitHub Search + REST API) — manual channel only, same as audit-deps. Emits a violation when the share is below target, so ralph/metric.sh can drive off it.

Median days an issue sits gated on Adrian under needs-adrian / needs-decision / needs-credential (ops#297, FRONTIER-DOCTRINE.md §7 metric 2), broken out per label, plus the oldest still-open gated issue. Network required (repo-wide GitHub issue-events feed) — manual channel only, same as metric-north-star-share. Emits a violation when the median is above target, so ralph/metric.sh can drive off it.

ops' vendored ClientConfig schema must offer every enum value site-engine ships. site-engine guards its schema against ops-shape.snapshot.json; nothing guarded the snapshot against ops, so shipped variants sat unreachable by the generation agent with every gate green (2026-09-16).

Compares supabase/migrations/*.sql against the live supabase_migrations.schema_migrations ledger and reports every migration the repo has but the ledger does not (and every ledger row no repo migration explains). Skips loudly when Supabase credentials are absent — it never reports "in sync" for a ledger it could not read.
pureExceptions: network: reads the live migration ledger through the Management API — that comparison is the entire gate
env: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN / SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF are the credentials it needs to reach the ledger
